Inspected the exact text described by Accellera SystemVerilog 3.1a LRM §4.2 Packed and unpacked arrays, opening paragraph, printed p. 32 (PDF p. 48). The Accellera SystemVerilog 3.1a reference requires a packed array to be represented as contiguous bits. The array is packed as defined by the 3.1a reference. The provision concerns the documented packed-array representation. Export formats, ABI choices, unpacked arrays and later standards have separate scopes. This sentence belongs to §4.2, after the explicitly informative §4.1. The following wording allows an unpacked array to use either representation, so the claim stays on packed arrays.
